claim_text: Our operations use minimal freshwater, depending heavily on groundwater abstraction, most of which is hypersaline or brackish and requires onsite reverse osmosis prior to use.
metric_name: Freshwater withdrawn; Total water withdrawals from groundwater sources

Most of our water inputs (87.5%) are from the abstraction of hypersaline or brackish groundwater, with only 1.1% of our water inputs from freshwater sources.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: The water snapshot directly supports the claim that freshwater use was minimal and groundwater dominated total withdrawals.
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that operations use “minimal freshwater” and rely heavily on groundwater that is “mostly hypersaline or brackish” requiring onsite reverse osmosis before use. The provided evidence only gives two withdrawal quantities (freshwater withdrawn: 14.5 ML; total water withdrawals from groundwater sources: 1,106.9 ML). While these numbers indicate groundwater withdrawals are much larger than the freshwater figure, the evidence does not substantiate that the groundwater is mostly hypersaline/brackish, does not mention reverse osmosis treatment, and does not define the timeframe or total freshwater withdrawals across all sources needed to verify “minimal freshwater” as written.
